title: chant workspace box listing set output
description: What `chant workspace box listing set <member> [--from <file|->] [--cover <image>]` prints (#3308): the box's listing before and after, the files the write changed, and the cover it copied, or the reason it wrote nothing. The write changes only members[i].box.listing in the declaration, in place, keeping the file's formatting and comments, and the cover file it copies. It never commits. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. The error codes are a closed list, each in the one closed list of `reason-codes.ts`. Contract version 1 of this document is written by chant 0.103.0 and newer.

result.description: The listing was written, or would be with --dry-run, or already held what was given (changed false). Exit code 0.

member.description: The member whose box block holds the listing.

path.description: The declaration file, relative to the repository root (the working directory outside git), with / separators.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the declaration's bytes after the write, or as they would be with --dry-run.

paths.description: Every file the write changed, or would change with --dry-run, relative to the repository root: the cover it copied, then the declaration. Empty when the listing and cover already held what was given.

changed.description: Whether any file changed: paths is not empty.

dryRun.description: True when --dry-run was given and nothing was written.

previous.description: The listing before the write, as chant workspace status --json prints it, or null when the box declared none.

listing.description: The listing after the write, as chant workspace status --json prints it, defaults filled in and the cover hashed.

cover.description: The image --cover copied in, or null without --cover.

path.description: Where it was copied, from the workspace root: --cover-path, else the listing's cover when its extension fits, else <member dir>/listing/cover.<png|jpg|webp>.

replaced.description: The cover the listing named before, from the workspace root, when it was another file. That file is left in place; the caller removes it in the same commit if nothing else uses it.
